name: Align
full_description: This occurs when data is accessed in a way that violates the system's alignment requirements, leading to crashes or degraded performance on certain architectures

name: Assertions
full_description: A failed assertion indicates that a critical assumption in the program was violated, which may result in unexpected behavior or termination

name: Atomicity
full_description: Happens in concurrent programming when an operation expected to be indivisible (atomic) is interrupted, causing data inconsistency

name: Bounds
full_description: Occurs when accessing an array or memory location outside its allocated range, leading to potential crashes or corruption

name: DataRaces
full_description: Happens when multiple threads access the same memory location simultaneously without proper synchronization, leading to unpredictable program behavior

name: Deadlock
full_description: Occurs when multiple threads wait indefinitely for resources held by each other, preventing execution from proceeding.

name: DivByZero
full_description: Happens when a number is divided by zero, leading to runtime crashes or undefined behavior in floating-point operations

name: LockOrder
full_description: Occurs when locks are acquired in an inconsistent order, increasing the likelihood of deadlocks

name: Nan
full_description: Happens when an invalid floating-point computation, such as 0/0, produces a NaN value, which can cause unintended behavior in numerical operations

name: Overflow
full_description: Happens when a numerical calculation exceeds the maximum value that a data type can hold, leading to unexpected results

name: Pointer
full_description: Occurs when dereferencing a null or uninitialized pointer, leading to segmentation faults or memory corruption

name: Struct Fields
full_description: Happens when accessing uninitialized struct fields or violating struct alignment rules, potentially causing memory corruption

name: Undefined Shift
full_description: Occurs when shifting values beyond their bit-width, resulting in unpredictable behavior

name: Unlimited Scanf
full_description: Using scanf without input size restrictions can lead to buffer overflows, causing memory corruption

name: Unsigned Overflow
full_description: When an unsigned integer exceeds its maximum value, it wraps around to zero, potentially causing incorrect logic execution

name: Vla Size
full_description: Declaring an excessively large VLA can result in stack overflow and runtime crashes

name: Use After Free
short_description: Accessing memory after it has been freed
full_description: Occurs when a program continues to use a memory location after freeing it, leading to crashes or security exploits

name: Buffer Overflow
full_description: Happens when a program writes more data than a buffer can hold, causing memory corruption or exploitation risks

name: Format String
full_description: Occurs when user-supplied input is incorrectly formatted, leading to memory leaks or remote code execution

name: Integer Underflow
short_description: Arithmetic result below minimum integer limit
full_description: Occurs when an integer calculation results in a value lower than its minimum representable range, potentially leading to unexpected behavior

name: Race Condition
short_description: Uncontrolled sequence of execution in multithreading
full_description: Happens when a program’s behavior depends on the sequence or timing of uncontrollable events, leading to unpredictable results

name: Heap Overflow
full_description: Similar to buffer overflow but occurs in dynamically allocated memory, leading to security exploits

name: Memory Leak
full_description: Happens when dynamically allocated memory is not freed, leading to excessive memory consumption and performance degradation
